title: Joined solids
summary: ECurves joins what belongs together: solids that meet along an edge - a plate against its trim, a joint against its glow - become one solid by themselves after a conversion or a bake (or from the menu), one of each shared edge kept and the meshes welded along it with no gap, quads kept, each part's material and bone weights still its own and no seam in the shading. A dragged model shows where it will land before you drop it, Merge by distance makes close vertices one, and Undo, Redo, Save and Save as sit on the header. Hovering a model, primitive, material or overview solid shows the item itself turning slowly in its tooltip, sharp at any screen size; the models browser has categories; and no text in the game is smaller than 14 px.

steps.title: Auto join: solids that meet become one
steps.text: A converted character is dozens of solids, and where two meet - an armour plate against its trim, a joint against its glow - each had its own copy of the same edge, with a seam between them. Auto join finds those pairs: an edge of each in the same place with the same shape, the surface stopping there on both sides, and only on the same bone. Each group is made one solid, one of each pair of edges kept. It runs after a conversion, after a bake, and from the menu (the selected solids, or all).

steps.title: Welded with no gap, quads kept
steps.text: The two sides of a seam rarely have their points in the same places. Where one side has a point the other lacks, a loop cut runs through the other side's quads from the seam - each quad split in two, carried across till an open side - so the seam gets that point and the faces stay quads. Then the points are made one: every side of the seam has a face on each side, nothing open. Where two pieces both had a face in one place (touching face to face) that inner wall goes, as a union would.

steps.title: Materials, weights and shading kept
steps.text: The joined solid keeps each part's material: a surface a material, every triangle the material of the solid it came from - found again after any edit or settle from a point inside each part, so a reshaped seam keeps its colours. The normals are worked out across the weld before the split, so there's no line in the shading where two materials meet. Bone weights come from the parts' old meshes joined into one, their bones numbered as the kept solid's skin numbers them.

steps.title: Drop marker, merge by distance, a cleaner toolbar
steps.text: Dragging a model, a primitive or a shape from a browser over the view now shows where it will land before you let go: a ring lying on the surface under the pointer, and the model's bounds standing there - and the drop uses the read it made, so it's added at once. Merge by distance (Alt+M) makes vertices within the merge distance one: next to each other on an edge, one is dissolved; on different edges, they meet at their middle. Undo, Redo and Save are back on the header, Save as beside Save.

+## An edge's points evenly along it (by length), `n` of them (a closed one: not repeating its first).
+static func even_points(c: Dictionary, xf: Transform3D, n := N_CMP) -> PackedVector3Array:
+	var s := CT.sample(c)
+	var closed := bool(c.get("closed", false))

+		s.append(s[0])
+	for i in s.size():
+		s[i] = xf * s[i]
+	var lens := PackedFloat32Array([0.0])
+	for i in range(1, s.size()):
+		lens.append(lens[i - 1] + s[i - 1].distance_to(s[i]))

+	var out := PackedVector3Array()

+		return out
+	var k := 0
+	var cnt := n if closed else n

+		"anchors": anchors(v, t, tmat)}
+
+
+## Whether two faces with the same corners go round them the same way.
+static func _same_way(a: Array, b: Array) -> bool:
+	var i: int = b.find(a[0])
+	return i >= 0 and int(b[(i + 1) % b.size()]) == int(a[1])
+
+
+## Each vertex's normal (the faces round it, by their area) - new points between two get theirs blended.
+static func _normals(st: Dictionary) -> void:
+	var v: Array = st["v"]
+	var n := []
+	n.resize(v.size())
+	n.fill(Vector3.ZERO)
+	for f in st["faces"]:
+		var fn := Vector3.ZERO
+		for j in (f as Array).size():
+			var a: Vector3 = v[f[j]]
+			var b: Vector3 = v[f[(j + 1) % f.size()]]
+			fn += Vector3((a.y - b.y) * (a.z + b.z), (a.z - b.z) * (a.x + b.x), (a.x - b.x) * (a.y + b.y))
+		for x in f:
+			n[int(x)] += fn
+	for i in n.size():
+		n[i] = (n[i] as Vector3).normalized() if (n[i] as Vector3).length_squared() > 1e-30 else Vector3.ZERO
+	st["nrm"] = n
+
+
+## The faces by their sides ({Vector2i(lo, hi): [faces]}), and each point's edges ({vertex: {chain: place}}).
+static func _index(st: Dictionary) -> void:
+	var em := {}
+	var faces: Array = st["faces"]
+	for fi in faces.size():
+		_add_sides(em, faces[fi], fi)
+	st["emap"] = em
+	var vf := {}
+	for f in faces:
+		for x in f:
+			vf[int(x)] = true
+	st["vfaces"] = vf
+	var on := {}
+	for e in st["fv"]:
+		if not on.has(int(e[0])):
+			on[int(e[0])] = {}
+		on[int(e[0])][int(e[1])] = float(e[2])
+	st["on"] = on
+
+
+static func _add_sides(em: Dictionary, f: Array, fi: int) -> void:
+	for j in f.size():
+		var k := _sk(int(f[j]), int(f[(j + 1) % f.size()]))
+		if not em.has(k):
+			em[k] = []
+		(em[k] as Array).append(fi)
+
+
+static func _drop_sides(em: Dictionary, f: Array, fi: int) -> void:
+	for j in f.size():
+		var k := _sk(int(f[j]), int(f[(j + 1) % f.size()]))
+		if em.has(k):
+			(em[k] as Array).erase(fi)
+			if (em[k] as Array).is_empty():
+				em.erase(k)
+
+
+static func _sk(a: int, b: int) -> Vector2i:
+	return Vector2i(mini(a, b), maxi(a, b))
+
+
+## Chain `k`'s points in order along it: [[place, vertex]...] (each vertex once).
+static func _chain_list(st: Dictionary, k: int) -> Array:
+	var lst := []
+	var seen := {}
+	var vf: Dictionary = st["vfaces"]
+	for e in st["fv"]:
+		if int(e[1]) == k and not seen.has(int(e[0])) and vf.has(int(e[0])):   # (a point no face uses: not on it)
+			seen[int(e[0])] = true
+			lst.append([float(e[2]), int(e[0])])
+	lst.sort_custom(func(x, y): return float(x[0]) < float(y[0]))
+	return lst
+
+
+## How far apart two places along an edge are (a closed one: round the shorter way).
+static func _pd(a: float, b: float, closed: bool) -> float:
+	var d := absf(a - b)
+	return minf(d, 1.0 - d) if closed else d
+
+
+## Edge `kb` welded onto edge `ka` (curve `c` - its shape, where the places along it are measured): each side
+## given the points the other has (a loop cut through its quads at each), then each point of kb made the
+## point of ka in its place. "" or why it couldn't be.
+static func _weld(st: Dictionary, ka: int, kb: int, c: Dictionary, closed: bool) -> String:
+	var v: Array = st["v"]
+	# (one point added at a time, both sides read again after each - a cut can come round through the
+	# quads and out on the seam again, adding a point there too)
+	var mt := {}
+	for round in 2000:
+		var la := _chain_list(st, ka)
+		var lb0 := _chain_list(st, kb)
+		if la.size() < 2 or lb0.size() < 2:
+			return "an edge with too few points"
+		var bp := PackedVector3Array()
+		for x in lb0:
+			bp.append(v[int(x[1])])
+		var tb := EN.params(bp, c)
+		var lb := []
+		for i in lb0.size():
+			lb.append([tb[i], int(lb0[i][1])])
+		lb.sort_custom(func(x, y): return float(x[0]) < float(y[0]))
+		mt = _match(la, lb, closed)
+		var a_matched := {}
+		for vb in mt:
+			a_matched[int(mt[vb])] = true
+		var done := true
+		for j in lb.size():
+			if mt.has(int(lb[j][1])):
+				continue
+			# (a b point with no a point: put on a's side - a cut through its quads there)
+			if _insert(st, la, float(lb[j][0]), v[int(lb[j][1])], closed, ka) < 0:
+				return "a seam point couldn't be put on the other side"
+			done = false
+			break
+		if not done:
+			continue
+		for i in la.size():
+			if a_matched.has(int(la[i][1])):
+				continue
+			# (an a point with no b point: put on b's side)
+			if _insert(st, lb, float(la[i][0]), v[int(la[i][1])], closed, kb) < 0:
+				return "a seam point couldn't be put on the other side"
+			done = false
+			break
+		if done:
+			break
+		if round == 1999:
+			return "a seam that wouldn't match up"
+	# the b points made the a points
+	var faces: Array = st["faces"]
+	for fi in faces.size():
+		var f: Array = faces[fi]
+		var ch := false
+		for j in f.size():
+			if mt.has(int(f[j])) and int(mt[int(f[j])]) != int(f[j]):
+				f[j] = mt[int(f[j])]
+				ch = true
+		if ch:
+			faces[fi] = f
+	for e in st["fv"]:
+		if mt.has(int(e[0])):
+			e[0] = mt[int(e[0])]
+	st["fv"] = (st["fv"] as Array).filter(func(e): return int(e[1]) != kb)
+	_index(st)
+	return ""
+
+
+## Each b point (of list `lb` - [[place, vertex]...] in order) matched to the a point at its place, when it's
+## nearer than 40% of the spacing either side (each a point to one b point at most). {b vertex: a vertex}.
+static func _match(la: Array, lb: Array, closed: bool) -> Dictionary:
+	var gap := func(l: Array, i: int) -> float:
+		var g := INF
+		var n := l.size()
+		for o in [-1, 1]:
+			var j: int = i + o
+			if closed:
+				j = (j + n) % n
+			elif j < 0 or j >= n:
+				continue
+			if j != i:
+				g = minf(g, _pd(float(l[i][0]), float(l[j][0]), closed))
+		return g if g < INF else 1.0
+	var best_b := {}   # a index -> [distance, b index]
+	for j in lb.size():
+		var pb: float = lb[j][0]
+		var bi := -1
+		var bd := INF
+		for i in la.size():
+			var d := _pd(pb, float(la[i][0]), closed)
+			if d < bd:
+				bd = d
+				bi = i
+		if bi >= 0 and (int(lb[j][1]) == int(la[bi][1]) or bd < 0.4 * minf(gap.call(la, bi), gap.call(lb, j))):
+			if not best_b.has(bi) or float(best_b[bi][0]) > bd:
+				best_b[bi] = [bd, j]
+	var out := {}
+	for i in best_b:
+		out[int(lb[int(best_b[i][1])][1])] = int(la[int(i)][1])
+	return out
+
+
+## A point put on the open border along a seam's list `l` (its points in order along the edge, [[place,
+## vertex]...]) at place `pt`, position `pos`: the border's side there cut, a row of quads cut through
+## from it (a loop cut) - the list kept in order; on edge `k` (>= 0: its place recorded). The new point.
+static func _insert(st: Dictionary, l: Array, pt: float, pos: Vector3, closed: bool, k: int) -> int:
+	var n := l.size()
+	var lo := -1
+	for i in n - 1:
+		if float(l[i][0]) <= pt and pt <= float(l[i + 1][0]):
+			lo = i
+			break
+	if lo < 0:
+		if not closed:
+			return -1
+		lo = n - 1   # (between its last point and round to its first)
+	var hi := (lo + 1) % n
+	var a: int = l[lo][1]
+	var b: int = l[hi][1]
+	var span := float(l[hi][0]) - float(l[lo][0])
+	if span <= 0.0:
+		span += 1.0
+	var into := pt - float(l[lo][0])
+	if into < 0.0:
+		into += 1.0
+	var s := clampf(into / span, 0.0, 1.0)
+	var nv := _cut(st, a, b, s, pos)
+	if nv < 0:
+		return -1
+	if k >= 0:
+		(st["fv"] as Array).append([nv, k, pt])
+		if not (st["on"] as Dictionary).has(nv):
+			st["on"][nv] = {}
+		st["on"][nv][k] = pt
+	l.insert(lo + 1, [pt, nv])   # (after its last point, round a closed edge: at the end)
+	return nv
+
+
+## A loop cut from the open side a-b, at `s` of the way from a to b (the new point at `pos`): the face
+## there split, and on through each quad across from it (each split into two quads) till an open side
+## or a triangle. The point made on a-b, or -1 (a-b isn't an open side).
+static func _cut(st: Dictionary, a: int, b: int, s: float, pos: Vector3) -> int:
+	var em: Dictionary = st["emap"]
+	var fs: Array = em.get(_sk(a, b), [])
+	if fs.size() != 1:
+		return -1
+	var v: Array = st["v"]
+	var nrm: Array = st["nrm"]
+	var faces: Array = st["faces"]
+	var fmat: Array = st["fmat"]
+	var p := v.size()
+	v.append(pos)
+	nrm.append(((nrm[a] as Vector3).lerp(nrm[b], s)).normalized())
+	st["vfaces"][p] = true
+	var first := p
+	var f: int = fs[0]
+	var ea := a
+	var eb := b
+	var guard := faces.size() * 4 + 8
+	while guard > 0:
+		guard -= 1
+		var F: Array = faces[f]
+		var nF := F.size()
+		var i := F.find(ea)
+		if i < 0:
+			break
+		if int(F[(i + 1) % nF]) != eb:
+			if int(F[(i - 1 + nF) % nF]) == eb:
+				# (this face runs the other way round: from b to a)
+				var tmp := ea
+				ea = eb
+				eb = tmp
+				s = 1.0 - s
+				i = F.find(ea)
+			else:
+				break
+		_drop_sides(em, F, f)
+		if nF == 3:
+			var c3: int = F[(i + 2) % 3]
+			faces[f] = [ea, p, c3]
+			faces.append([p, eb, c3])
+			fmat.append(fmat[f])
+			st["fsrc"].append(st["fsrc"][f])
+			_add_sides(em, faces[f], f)
+			_add_sides(em, faces[faces.size() - 1], faces.size() - 1)
+			break
+		var c: int = F[(i + 2) % 4]
+		var d: int = F[(i + 3) % 4]
+		# (the side across: d (across from a) to c (across from b) - the point on it at s)
+		var q: int = _between(st, d, c, s)
+		faces[f] = [ea, p, q, d]
+		faces.append([p, eb, c, q])
+		fmat.append(fmat[f])
+		st["fsrc"].append(st["fsrc"][f])
+		_add_sides(em, faces[f], f)
+		_add_sides(em, faces[faces.size() - 1], faces.size() - 1)
+		var nxt: Array = (em.get(_sk(d, c), []) as Array).filter(func(x): return int(x) != f and int(x) != faces.size() - 1)
+		if nxt.is_empty():
+			break
+		f = nxt[0]
+		ea = d
+		eb = c
+		p = q
+	return first
+
+
+## A new point on side d-c at `s` of the way from d: on the surface (bent by the two ends' normals where
+## they're near alike - a curved surface's row stays on it), on an edge if both ends are on it.
+static func _between(st: Dictionary, d: int, c: int, s: float) -> int:
+	var v: Array = st["v"]
+	var nrm: Array = st["nrm"]
+	var p0: Vector3 = v[d]
+	var p1: Vector3 = v[c]
+	var n0: Vector3 = nrm[d]
+	var n1: Vector3 = nrm[c]
+	var w := p1 - p0
+	var pos := p0.lerp(p1, s)
+	if n0 != Vector3.ZERO and n1 != Vector3.ZERO and n0.dot(n1) > cos(deg_to_rad(40.0)):
+		var b1 := p0 + (w - w.dot(n0) * n0) / 3.0
+		var b2 := p1 - (w - w.dot(n1) * n1) / 3.0
+		var u := 1.0 - s
+		pos = p0 * u * u * u + b1 * 3.0 * u * u * s + b2 * 3.0 * u * s * s + p1 * s * s * s
+	var q := v.size()
+	v.append(pos)
+	st["vfaces"][q] = true
+	nrm.append(n0.lerp(n1, s).normalized() if n0.lerp(n1, s).length_squared() > 1e-30 else n0)
+	# (on an edge both its ends are on, next to each other along it: there too)
+	var on: Dictionary = st["on"]
+	if on.has(d) and on.has(c):
+		for k in on[d]:
+			if not (on[c] as Dictionary).has(k):
+				continue
+			var td: float = on[d][k]
+			var tc: float = on[c][k]
+			var tq := lerpf(td, tc, s)
+			if absf(tc - td) > 0.5:
+				# (across a closed edge's start: round it the short way)
+				tc += 1.0 if tc < td else -1.0
+				tq = fposmod(lerpf(td, tc, s), 1.0)
+			(st["fv"] as Array).append([q, int(k), tq])
+			if not on.has(q):
+				on[q] = {}
+			on[q][k] = tq
+	return q
+
+
+## Each material's places inside it: [[a point, material]...] - one a stretch of each material (the
+## triangle nearest the middle of it). Found again after edits: the stretch holding the triangle nearest a
+## point is that point's material.
+static func anchors(v: PackedVector3Array, t: PackedInt32Array, tmat: PackedInt32Array) -> Array:
+	var comp := _stretches(v, t, func(ta: int, tb: int) -> bool: return tmat[ta] == tmat[tb])
+	var sums := {}
+	for ti in comp.size():
+		var c := comp[ti]
+		var ctr := (v[t[ti * 3]] + v[t[ti * 3 + 1]] + v[t[ti * 3 + 2]]) / 3.0
+		if not sums.has(c):
+			sums[c] = [Vector3.ZERO, 0]
+		sums[c][0] += ctr
+		sums[c][1] += 1
+	var out := []
+	for c in sums:
+		var mid: Vector3 = sums[c][0] / float(sums[c][1])
+		var best := -1
+		var bd := INF
+		for ti in comp.size():
+			if comp[ti] != c:
+				continue
+			var ctr := (v[t[ti * 3]] + v[t[ti * 3 + 1]] + v[t[ti * 3 + 2]]) / 3.0
+			if ctr.distance_squared_to(mid) < bd:
+				bd = ctr.distance_squared_to(mid)
+				best = ti
+		var ctr2 := (v[t[best * 3]] + v[t[best * 3 + 1]] + v[t[best * 3 + 2]]) / 3.0
+		out.append([[ctr2.x, ctr2.y, ctr2.z], tmat[best]])
+	return out
+
+
+## Triangles in stretches: joined across a side when `same(ta, tb)` says so. Each triangle's stretch.
+static func _stretches(_v: PackedVector3Array, t: PackedInt32Array, same: Callable) -> PackedInt32Array:
+	var nt := t.size() / 3
+	var by_e := {}
+	for ti in nt:
+		for j in 3:
+			var k := _sk(t[ti * 3 + j], t[ti * 3 + (j + 1) % 3])
+			if not by_e.has(k):
+				by_e[k] = []
+			(by_e[k] as Array).append(ti)
+	var comp := PackedInt32Array()
+	comp.resize(nt)
+	comp.fill(-1)
+	var nc := 0
+	for t0 in nt:
+		if comp[t0] >= 0:
+			continue
+		comp[t0] = nc
+		var todo := [t0]
+		while not todo.is_empty():
+			var ti: int = todo.pop_back()
+			for j in 3:
+				for o in by_e[_sk(t[ti * 3 + j], t[ti * 3 + (j + 1) % 3])]:
+					if comp[o] < 0 and same.call(ti, o):
+						comp[o] = nc
+						todo.append(o)
+		nc += 1
+	return comp
+
+
+## Each triangle's material in a joined solid as it is now: its stretches (split at the edges between two
+## materials - `seams`, by chain index), each the material of the anchor nearest it.
+static func tri_materials(v: PackedVector3Array, t: PackedInt32Array, fv: Array, seam_chains: Dictionary, anchor_list: Array) -> PackedInt32Array:
+	# (the sides along a seam: two points next to each other on it)
+	var blocked := {}
+	var by_c := {}
+	for e in fv:
+		if seam_chains.has(int(e[1])):
+			if not by_c.has(int(e[1])):
+				by_c[int(e[1])] = []
+			by_c[int(e[1])].append([float(e[2]), int(e[0])])
+	for k in by_c:
+		var l: Array = by_c[k]
+		l.sort_custom(func(x, y): return float(x[0]) < float(y[0]))
+		for i in range(1, l.size()):
+			blocked[_sk(int(l[i - 1][1]), int(l[i][1]))] = true
+		if l.size() > 2:
+			blocked[_sk(int(l[0][1]), int(l.back()[1]))] = true   # (a closed one's last side - harmless on an open one: not a side)
+	var nt := t.size() / 3
+	var shared := func(ta: int, tb: int) -> bool:
+		var a := [t[ta * 3], t[ta * 3 + 1], t[ta * 3 + 2]]
+		var cnt := 0
+		var x := -1
+		var y := -1
+		for j in 3:
+			var q := t[tb * 3 + j]
+			if q in a:
+				if cnt == 0:
+					x = q
+				else:
+					y = q
+				cnt += 1
+		return cnt < 2 or not blocked.has(_sk(x, y))
+	var comp := _stretches(v, t, shared)
+	var out := PackedInt32Array()
+	out.resize(nt)
+	out.fill(0)
+	if anchor_list.is_empty():
+		return out
+	var cm := {}
+	var ctrs := PackedVector3Array()
+	ctrs.resize(nt)
+	for ti in nt:
+		ctrs[ti] = (v[t[ti * 3]] + v[t[ti * 3 + 1]] + v[t[ti * 3 + 2]]) / 3.0
+	for an in anchor_list:
+		var ap := Vector3(an[0][0], an[0][1], an[0][2])
+		var best := -1
+		var bd := INF
+		for ti in nt:
+			var d := ctrs[ti].distance_squared_to(ap)
+			if d < bd:
+				bd = d
+				best = ti
+		if best >= 0 and not cm.has(comp[best]):
+			cm[comp[best]] = int(an[1])
+	# (a stretch no anchor fell in: the material of the anchor nearest its middle)
+	var mids := {}
+	for ti in nt:
+		if not mids.has(comp[ti]):
+			mids[comp[ti]] = [Vector3.ZERO, 0]
+		mids[comp[ti]][0] += ctrs[ti]
+		mids[comp[ti]][1] += 1
+	for c in mids:
+		if cm.has(c):
+			continue
+		var mid: Vector3 = mids[c][0] / float(mids[c][1])
+		var bd := INF
+		for an in anchor_list:
+			var d := Vector3(an[0][0], an[0][1], an[0][2]).distance_squared_to(mid)
+			if d < bd:
+				bd = d
+				cm[c] = int(an[1])
+	for ti in nt:
+		out[ti] = int(cm.get(comp[ti], 0))
+	return out
+
+
+## A one-surface mesh split into a surface a material (`labels`: each triangle's; `mats`: the materials) -
+## every surface there, in order (an empty one a single point-sized triangle), each point's normal and
+## everything else as it was (no seam in the shading where two materials meet).
+static func split_by(m: ArrayMesh, labels: PackedInt32Array, mats: Array) -> ArrayMesh:
+	var a := m.surface_get_arrays(0)
+	var idx: PackedInt32Array = a[Mesh.ARRAY_INDEX] if a[Mesh.ARRAY_INDEX] != null else PackedInt32Array(range((a[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX] as PackedVector3Array).size()))
+	var nv: int = (a[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX] as PackedVector3Array).size()
+	var fmt := m.surface_get_format(0)
+	var flags := 0
+	for ch in 4:
+		flags |= fmt & (Mesh.ARRAY_FORMAT_CUSTOM_MASK << (Mesh.ARRAY_FORMAT_CUSTOM0_SHIFT + ch * Mesh.ARRAY_FORMAT_CUSTOM_BITS))
+	var out := ArrayMesh.new()
+	for L in mats.size():
+		var remap := PackedInt32Array()
+		remap.resize(nv)
+		remap.fill(-1)
+		var order := PackedInt32Array()
+		var ix := PackedInt32Array()
+		for ti in idx.size() / 3:
+			if (labels[ti] if ti < labels.size() else 0) != L:
+				continue
+			for j in 3:
+				var vi := idx[ti * 3 + j]
+				if remap[vi] < 0:
+					remap[vi] = order.size()
+					order.append(vi)
+				ix.append(remap[vi])

+	var AJ: GDScript = load("res://scripts/editor/mesh/auto_join.gd")
+	var inv := _mx().affine_inverse()
+	var cand := []
+	var solids := []
+	var mats := []   # (every material, once: the solids' by their number in it)
+	var users := {}   # curve id -> how many solids use it
+	for q: MeshInstance3D in ed.parts():
+		for id in spec_ids(q.get_meta("curve_solid", {})):
+			users[int(id)] = int(users.get(int(id), 0)) + 1
+	for p in ps:
+		if not (p is MeshInstance3D) or not is_instance_valid(p) or not (p as Node).is_inside_tree() or not (p as Node3D).is_visible_in_tree():
+			continue
+		var sp: Dictionary = (p as Node).get_meta("curve_solid", {})
+		if str(sp.get("kind", "")) != "edges" or not sp.has("mesh") or sp.has("faces") or (p as MeshInstance3D).mesh == null:
+			continue
+		if (sp.get("ids", []) as Array).any(func(id): return int(users.get(int(id), 0)) > 1):
+			continue   # (an edge another solid uses too: left as it is)
+		var cs := {}
+		for id in sp.get("ids", []):
+			cs[int(id)] = curve_by_id(int(id))
+		var mat := _join_material(p)
+		var mi := mats.find(mat)
+		if mi < 0:
+			mi = mats.size()
+			mats.append(mat)
+		var skinned: bool = (p as Node).has_meta("weight_src") or (p as MeshInstance3D).skin != null
+		solids.append({"group": "%s|%s" % [str(sp.get("bone_name", "")), skinned], "xf": inv * (p as Node3D).global_transform, "spec": sp,
+			"curves": cs, "mat": mi, "v": sp["mesh"]["v"], "t": sp["mesh"]["t"], "fv": sp.get("fv", []), "chains": sp.get("chains", []), "c0": sp.get("c0", {})})
+		cand.append(p)
+	if solids.size() < 2:
+		if not quiet:
+			ed._say("Auto join: no two solids made from edges to look at.")
+		return false
+	var must_i := {}
+	for p in must:
+		var i := cand.find(p)
+		if i >= 0:
+			must_i[i] = true
+	var tol := merge_dist()
+	var h := [null]
+	var id := WorkerThreadPool.add_task(func(): h[0] = _join_compute(AJ, solids, tol, must_i), false, "ECurves: auto join")

+## A solid's material (what it's drawn with).
+static func _join_material(p: MeshInstance3D) -> Material:
+	if p.material_override:
+		return p.material_override
+	if p.mesh and p.mesh.get_surface_count() > 0:
+		return p.get_surface_override_material(0) if p.get_surface_override_material(0) else p.mesh.surface_get_material(0)
+	return null

+## (on a worker) The pairs of edges, the groups of solids they join, each group joined. [{members (solids by
+## number, the first kept), rels (each one's place in the first's), r (auto_join.join's result)}...].
+static func _join_compute(AJ: GDScript, solids: Array, tol: float, must_i: Dictionary) -> Array:
+	var pairs: Array = AJ.find_pairs(solids, tol)
+	if pairs.is_empty():
+		return []
+	# groups: solids linked by pairs
+	var root := range(solids.size())
+	var find := func(x: int, rt: Array) -> int:
+		while int(rt[x]) != x:
+			x = int(rt[x])
+		return x
+	for pr in pairs:
+		var a: int = find.call(int(pr[0]), root)
+		var b: int = find.call(int(pr[2]), root)
+		if a != b:
+			root[b] = a
+	var groups := {}
+	for pr in pairs:
+		var g: int = find.call(int(pr[0]), root)
+		if not groups.has(g):
+			groups[g] = {"members": [], "pairs": []}
+		for k in [int(pr[0]), int(pr[2])]:
+			if not k in groups[g]["members"]:
+				(groups[g]["members"] as Array).append(k)
+		(groups[g]["pairs"] as Array).append(pr)
+	var out := []
+	for g in groups:
+		var mem: Array = groups[g]["members"]
+		if not must_i.is_empty() and not mem.any(func(k): return must_i.has(int(k))):
+			continue
+		# (the one with the most triangles kept - the others brought into its place)
+		mem.sort_custom(func(x, y): return (solids[x]["t"] as Array).size() > (solids[y]["t"] as Array).size())
+		var a_xf: Transform3D = solids[mem[0]]["xf"]
+		var parts := []
+		var rels := {}
+		var where := {}
+		for li in mem.size():
+			var s: Dictionary = solids[mem[li]]
+			where[int(mem[li])] = li
+			var rel: Transform3D = a_xf.affine_inverse() * (s["xf"] as Transform3D)
+			rels[int(mem[li])] = rel
+			var mv: Array = s["v"]
+			var v := PackedVector3Array()
+			v.resize(mv.size() / 3)
+			for i in v.size():
+				v[i] = rel * Vector3(mv[i * 3], mv[i * 3 + 1], mv[i * 3 + 2])
+			var c0 := {}
+			var src_c0: Dictionary = s["c0"]
+			for k in src_c0:
+				var cs := from_json([src_c0[k]])
+				if not cs.is_empty():
+					c0[k] = to_json([baked(cs[0], rel) if li > 0 else cs[0]])[0]
+			parts.append({"v": v, "t": PackedInt32Array(s["t"]), "fv": s["fv"], "chains": s["chains"], "c0": c0, "mat": int(s["mat"])})
+		var jp := []
+		for pr in groups[g]["pairs"]:
+			var ca := _chain_at(solids[int(pr[0])]["chains"], int(pr[1]))
+			var cb := _chain_at(solids[int(pr[2])]["chains"], int(pr[3]))
+			var la: int = where[int(pr[0])]
+			var lb: int = where[int(pr[2])]
+			if lb < la:
+				# (the kept solid's edge kept: the pair turned round)
+				jp.append([lb, cb, la, ca])
+			else:
+				jp.append([la, ca, lb, cb])
+		jp.sort_custom(func(x, y): return int(x[2]) < int(y[2]))
+		out.append({"members": mem, "rels": rels, "r": AJ.join(parts, jp)})
+	return out
+

+static func _chain_at(chains: Array, id: int) -> int:
+	for ci in chains.size():
+		if int(chains[ci]["id"]) == id:
+			return ci
+	return -1

+## (each frame) An auto join worked out: put in - one undo step for all its groups.
+func _join_step() -> void:
+	var j: Array = get_meta("join_job")
+	if not WorkerThreadPool.is_task_completed(int(j[0])):
+		return
+	WorkerThreadPool.wait_for_task_completion(int(j[0]))
+	remove_meta("join_job")
+	var res = j[1][0]
+	var cand: Array = j[2]
+	var solids: Array = j[3]
+	var mats: Array = j[4]
+	var quiet: bool = j[5]
+	var groups := []
+	var failed := 0
+	for g: Dictionary in (res if res is Array else []):
+		if (g["r"] as Dictionary).has("error"):
+			failed += 1
+			continue
+		var ok := true
+		for k in g["members"]:
+			var p = cand[int(k)]
+			# (changed since it was looked at - edited, deleted: that group left out)
+			if not is_instance_valid(p) or not (p as Node).is_inside_tree() or (p as Node).get_meta("curve_solid", {}) != solids[int(k)]["spec"]:
+				ok = false
+		if ok:
+			groups.append(g)
+	if groups.is_empty():
+		if not quiet or failed > 0:
+			ed._say("Auto join: no solids meet along an edge%s." % ((" (%d group%s couldn't be welded)" % [failed, "" if failed == 1 else "s"]) if failed > 0 else ""))
+		return
+	var before := _state()
+	var rows_before := []
+	var rows_after := []
+	var outs := []
+	var n_parts := 0
+	var n_shared := 0
+	for g: Dictionary in groups:
+		var mem: Array = g["members"]
+		var r: Dictionary = g["r"]
+		var a: MeshInstance3D = cand[int(mem[0])]
+		var keep_ids := {}
+		for id in r["ids"]:
+			keep_ids[int(id)] = true
+		# the others' edges brought into the kept one's place (it carries them now); the dropped ones gone
+		var dropped := {}
+		for li in range(1, mem.size()):
+			var rel: Transform3D = g["rels"][int(mem[li])]
+			for id in (solids[int(mem[li])]["spec"] as Dictionary).get("ids", []):
+				var ci := _curve_index(int(id))
+				if ci < 0:
+					continue
+				if keep_ids.has(int(id)):
+					curves[ci] = baked(curves[ci], rel)
+				else:
+					dropped[int(id)] = true
+		for id in (solids[int(mem[0])]["spec"] as Dictionary).get("ids", []):
+			if not keep_ids.has(int(id)):
+				dropped[int(id)] = true
+		curves = curves.filter(func(c): return not dropped.has(int(c.get("id", -1))))
+		n_shared += dropped.size()
+		# the materials: the kept one's first
+		var local := []
+		var gl := []
+		for k in mem:
+			var gi: int = solids[int(k)]["mat"]
+			if not gi in gl:
+				gl.append(gi)
+				local.append(mats[gi])
+		var flat := []
+		for q in (r["v"] as PackedVector3Array):
+			flat.append_array([q.x, q.y, q.z])
+		var a_spec: Dictionary = solids[int(mem[0])]["spec"]
+		var spec := {"kind": "edges", "ids": r["ids"], "net": int(Time.get_ticks_usec() % 2000000000) + n_parts, "chains": r["chains"], "c0": r["c0"],
+			"mesh": {"v": flat, "t": Array(r["t"])}, "fv": r["fv"], "tied": true, "qcaps": true, "sealed": false, "paired": false,
+			"dense": (mem.map(func(k): return int((solids[int(k)]["spec"] as Dictionary).get("dense", 0))) as Array).max(), "joined": mem.size()}
+		for key in ["converted", "up", "bone", "bone_name"]:
+			if a_spec.has(key):
+				spec[key] = a_spec[key]
+		if local.size() > 1:
+			spec["mats"] = {"anchors": (r["anchors"] as Array).map(func(an): return [an[0], gl.find(int(an[1]))]),
+				"seams": r["seams"]}
+		var metas_before := {}
+		var metas_after := {}
+		for key in ["ecurve_mats", "mats_mesh", "weight_src", "ecurve_skin", "weighted"]:
+			metas_before[key] = a.get_meta(key) if a.has_meta(key) else null
+			metas_after[key] = null
+		metas_after["ecurve_mats"] = local if local.size() > 1 else null
+		var wm := _joined_weights(a, mem.map(func(k): return cand[int(k)]), mem.map(func(k): return g["rels"][int(k)]))
+		for key in ["weight_src", "ecurve_skin"]:
+			metas_after[key] = wm.get(key, metas_before[key])
+		rows_before.append([a, a_spec, metas_before, a.mesh])
+		rows_after.append([a, spec, metas_after, null])
+		for li in range(1, mem.size()):
+			var q: MeshInstance3D = cand[int(mem[li])]
+			outs.append([q, q.get_parent(), q.get_index()])
+		n_parts += mem.size()
+	sel = []
+	_join_set(rows_after, [], outs, true)
+	var after := _state()
+	_join_set(rows_after, after, outs, true)
+	ed._push("Auto join", _join_set.bind(rows_before, before, outs, false), _join_set.bind(rows_after, after, outs, true))
+	ed._say("Auto join: %d solids made %d - %d shared edge%s welded%s." % [n_parts, groups.size(), n_shared, "" if n_shared == 1 else "s",
+		(" (%d group%s couldn't be welded)" % [failed, "" if failed == 1 else "s"]) if failed > 0 else ""])
+

+## Rows of [solid, recipe, metas ({name: value or null - none}), mesh or null] put in; `outs` taken out of the
+## model (`gone`) or put back; then the edges as in state `st` (when it's given).
+func _join_set(rows: Array, st: Array, outs: Array, gone: bool) -> void:
+	for e in outs:
+		var q: Node = e[0]
+		if not is_instance_valid(q):
+			continue
+		if gone and q.get_parent():
+			q.get_parent().remove_child(q)
+		elif not gone and q.get_parent() == null and is_instance_valid(e[1]):
+			(e[1] as Node).add_child(q)
+			(e[1] as Node).move_child(q, mini(int(e[2]), (e[1] as Node).get_child_count() - 1))
+	if gone:
+		ed.sel_parts = (ed.sel_parts as Array).filter(func(q): return is_instance_valid(q) and q.is_inside_tree())
+		if ed.part != null and (not is_instance_valid(ed.part) or not (ed.part as Node).is_inside_tree()):
+			ed.select_part(null)
+	for row in rows:
+		var p: MeshInstance3D = row[0]
+		if not is_instance_valid(p):
+			continue
+		p.set_meta("curve_solid", row[1])
+		p.remove_meta("curve_solid_key")
+		for key in (row[2] as Dictionary):
+			if row[2][key] == null:
+				p.remove_meta(key)
+			else:
+				p.set_meta(key, row[2][key])
+		if row[3] != null:
+			p.mesh = row[3]
+	remove_meta("mat_parts_at")   # (the solids with materials of their own: looked for again)
+	if not st.is_empty():
+		_set_state(st)
+	else:
+		refresh_solids()
+	ed._fill_parts()
+	var t = _w("tree")
+	if t:
+		(t as Node).set_meta("sig", 0)
+	_refresh_panel()

+## The joined solid's bone weights: the solids' old meshes (where their weights come from) as one, in the
+## kept one's place, their bones numbered as the kept one's skin numbers them (a bone it hasn't, added).
+## {weight_src, ecurve_skin} - or {} (no weights).
+func _joined_weights(a: MeshInstance3D, members: Array, rels: Array) -> Dictionary:
+	var skin_of := func(q: MeshInstance3D) -> Skin:
+		if q.has_meta("ecurve_skin"):
+			return q.get_meta("ecurve_skin")
+		if q.has_meta("src_skin"):
+			return q.get_meta("src_skin")
+		return q.skin
+	if not members.any(func(q): return (q as Node).has_meta("weight_src")):
+		return {}
+	var base: Skin = skin_of.call(a)
+	var skin: Skin = base.duplicate() if base else Skin.new()
+	var bind_key := func(s: Skin, i: int) -> String:
+		var nm := str(s.get_bind_name(i))
+		return nm if nm != "" else "#%d" % s.get_bind_bone(i)
+	var index := {}
+	for i in skin.get_bind_count():
+		index[bind_key.call(skin, i)] = i
+	var out := ArrayMesh.new()
+	for mi in members.size():
+		var q: MeshInstance3D = members[mi]
+		if not q.has_meta("weight_src"):
+			continue
+		var src: Mesh = q.get_meta("weight_src")
+		var qs: Skin = skin_of.call(q)
+		var remap := PackedInt32Array()
+		if qs:
+			for i in qs.get_bind_count():
+				var k: String = bind_key.call(qs, i)
+				if not index.has(k):
+					index[k] = skin.get_bind_count()
+					if str(qs.get_bind_name(i)) != "":
+						skin.add_named_bind(qs.get_bind_name(i), qs.get_bind_pose(i))
+					else:
+						skin.add_bind(qs.get_bind_bone(i), qs.get_bind_pose(i))
+				remap.append(int(index[k]))
+		var rel: Transform3D = rels[mi]
+		for si in src.get_surface_count():
+			if src.surface_get_primitive_type(si) != Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES:
+				continue
+			var arr := src.surface_get_arrays(si)
+			var v: PackedVector3Array = arr[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX]
+			for i in v.size():
+				v[i] = rel * v[i]
+			arr[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX] = v
+			if arr[Mesh.ARRAY_NORMAL] != null:
+				var n: PackedVector3Array = arr[Mesh.ARRAY_NORMAL]
+				for i in n.size():
+					n[i] = (rel.basis * n[i]).normalized()
+				arr[Mesh.ARRAY_NORMAL] = n
+			arr[Mesh.ARRAY_TANGENT] = null
+			var flags := 0
+			if arr[Mesh.ARRAY_BONES] != null and not remap.is_empty():
+				var b: PackedInt32Array = arr[Mesh.ARRAY_BONES]
+				for i in b.size():
+					b[i] = remap[b[i]] if b[i] >= 0 and b[i] < remap.size() else b[i]
+				arr[Mesh.ARRAY_BONES] = b
+				if b.size() == v.size() * 8:
+					flags = Mesh.ARRAY_FLAG_USE_8_BONE_WEIGHTS
+			out.add_surface_from_arrays(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES, arr, [], {}, flags)
+	return {"weight_src": out, "ecurve_skin": skin}

+		set_meta("mat_parts_at", Time.get_ticks_msec() + 500)   # (looked for twice a second - a model opened, an undo)

+func _mats_apply(p: MeshInstance3D) -> void:
+	var sp: Dictionary = p.get_meta("curve_solid", {})
+	var md = sp.get("mats")
+	var m := p.mesh as ArrayMesh
+	if not (md is Dictionary) or m == null or (p.has_meta("mats_mesh") and p.get_meta("mats_mesh") == m):
+		return
+	var n := 0
+	for an in md.get("anchors", []):
+		n = maxi(n, int(an[1]) + 1)
+	var mats: Array = p.get_meta("ecurve_mats") if p.has_meta("ecurve_mats") else []
+	if mats.size() != n:
+		# (opened from a file: saved a surface a material, in order - its materials from there)
+		if m.get_surface_count() == n:
+			mats = []
+			for si in n:
+				mats.append(m.surface_get_material(si))
+			p.set_meta("ecurve_mats", mats)
+		p.set_meta("mats_mesh", m)
+		return
+	if m.get_surface_count() != 1:
+		p.set_meta("mats_mesh", m)
+		return
+	var AJ: GDScript = load("res://scripts/editor/mesh/auto_join.gd")
+	var t: Array = sp["mesh"]["t"]
+	var key := [int(sp.get("net", 0)), t.size(), hash(t)]
+	var lab: PackedInt32Array
+	var cached = p.get_meta("mats_lab") if p.has_meta("mats_lab") else null
+	if cached is Array and (cached as Array)[0] == key:
+		lab = cached[1]
+	else:
+		var mv: Array = sp["mesh"]["v"]
+		var v := PackedVector3Array()
+		v.resize(mv.size() / 3)
+		for i in v.size():
+			v[i] = Vector3(mv[i * 3], mv[i * 3 + 1], mv[i * 3 + 2])
+		var seam := {}
+		var chains: Array = sp.get("chains", [])
+		for ci in chains.size():
+			if int(chains[ci]["id"]) in (md.get("seams", []) as Array).map(func(x): return int(x)):
+				seam[ci] = true
+		lab = AJ.tri_materials(v, PackedInt32Array(t), sp.get("fv", []), seam, md.get("anchors", []))
+		p.set_meta("mats_lab", [key, lab])
+	var nt := 0
+	var idx = m.surface_get_arrays(0)[Mesh.ARRAY_INDEX]
+	nt = (idx as PackedInt32Array).size() / 3 if idx != null else 0
+	if nt != lab.size():
+		return   # (drawn from other triangles than its recipe's - a moment mid-edit: split once they agree)
+	var out: ArrayMesh = AJ.split_by(m, lab, mats)
+	p.mesh = out
+	p.set_meta("mats_mesh", out)

+# --- merge by distance ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## Merge by distance: the vertices within the merge distance of each other made one - next to each other
+## on one edge: the later one dissolved (its edge keeps its shape through the other); on different edges:
+## moved together to their middle, so the edges meet there (the solids made from them follow). The picked
+## vertices (two or more), else the picked edges', else the picked solid's, else every edge's. One undo
+## step. How many vertices were merged away or welded.
+func merge_by_distance() -> int:
+	var md := maxf(merge_dist(), 1e-6)
+	var scope := {}   # curve index -> {j: true} (or true: all its points)
+	var pp := picked_points()
+	if pp.size() >= 2:
+		for e in pp:
+			if not scope.has(int(e[0])):
+				scope[int(e[0])] = {}
+			scope[int(e[0])][int(e[1])] = true
+	elif not sel.is_empty():
+		for ci in sel:
+			scope[int(ci)] = true
+	elif picked_solid() != null:
+		for id in spec_ids(picked_solid().get_meta("curve_solid", {})):
+			var ci := _curve_index(int(id))
+			if ci >= 0:
+				scope[ci] = true
+	else:
+		for ci in curves.size():
+			scope[ci] = true
+	var own := owner_xfs()
+	var pts := []   # [curve, point, position in the model]
+	for ci in scope:
+		var c: Dictionary = curves[ci]
+		if not str(c.get("kind", "")) in ["line", "spline", "path"]:
+			continue   # (a circle's, an arc's points aren't its vertices along it)
+		var x := cx(c, own)
+		var k: PackedVector3Array = c["ctrl"]
+		for j in k.size():
+			if scope[ci] is Dictionary and not (scope[ci] as Dictionary).has(j):
+				continue

+	var it := t.get_item_at_position(at)
+	if it == null:
+		return ""
+	var col := t.get_column_at_position(at)
+	var bid := t.get_button_id_at_position(at)
+	if bid >= 0 and it.has_meta("btip_%d" % bid):
+		return str(it.get_meta("btip_%d" % bid))   # (a button's: kept for PinTips only)
+	if bid >= 0 and col >= 0:
+		var bi := it.get_button_by_id(col, bid)
+		if bi >= 0:
+			var key := "btip_%d_%d" % [col, bi]
+			var bt := it.get_button_tooltip_text(col, bi)
+			if bt != "":

+				it.set_button_tooltip_text(col, bi, "")
